text: My office has recently received a petition from residents of Paisley Avenue asking that their street move to 1-Hr parking during the weekdays. They have expressed their frustration that people are not obeying the current 3-hr restriction and that enforcement is scarce. Their proximity to a large employment site, lack of off-street parking for most residents, and a general increase in demand has put this small street under pressure.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 1 hour from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on the north side of Paisley Avenue, between Logan Avenue and Booth Avenue.
